novel.justification: Declared positive and structural-zero events are auditable inputs in finite systems with protocol-impossible states, deterministic routing, or registry-enforced exclusions. This input may contain arbitrary marginal or joint zeros; it is distinct from Chen--Darwiche Theorem 15's separability and parent conditions and from Theorem 18's treatment-marginal positivity set \(C_V=\{\Pr(X)>0:X\text{ is a treatment variable}\}\).
